text.p: Citizens Utilities Co unit Electric Lightwave Inc said Friday it has acquired TeleCard Services International.
Electric Lightwave, a full-service communications provider, did not disclose terms of the deal.
TeleCard Services, established in 1994, sells wholesale, prepaid calling card services to small and medium-sized businesses.
Electric Lightwave said in a statement the acquisition was a cost-effective way to establish itself in the pre-paid calling card market.

Russell Davis, president of TeleCard will continue to run Electric Lightwave's new telecard division. No lay-offs are planned and TeleCard will continue to operate from its headquarters near Portland International Airport.
